kfn.description: Exact k farthest-neighbor search (k=10) over road-network object sets. Benefit: how few objects a method has to retrieve individually and how few exact network distances it computes, relative to evaluating every object. Constraints: every answer exact, index size and index construction work within budget.
kfn.notes: colt / colt_default / alt_filter / bruteforce rows are produced by this workspace's pipeline in the paper setting (eval/evaluate.py: original NW travel times, real POI categories). PRELIMINARY until the first full paper-setting job: colt_default and alt_filter rows are from the held-out smoke run 9fc1dbc3-96c, colt copies colt_default. colt_phl_paper / aub_phl_paper are read off the paper's log-scale Figure 11c/11d (continental US network, uniform objects at d=0.0001, i.e. ~2.4k objects, the closest object-set size to this benchmark) and are approximate.

log10_candidate_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|P|+1)/(objects revealed+1)); 0 = every object retrieved individually.

log10_call_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|Q||P|+1)/(exact distance computations+1)); 0 = brute force.

exact_answer_rate.description: Fraction of exact answers (ties at the k-th distance accepted). Any wrong answer, crash or protocol violation scores the method with the worst value of every metric.

index_entries_per_vertex.description: Landmark distance-list entries per road-network vertex (index size). Capped at 40 for kFN.

sdl_work_per_vertex.description: Vertices settled while building the landmark distance lists, per vertex (index construction cost). Capped at 400.

aknn.description: Exact aggregate k nearest-neighbor search (k=10, |Q|=8 query vertices drawn from a 15% subnetwork, max and sum aggregates). Same benefit and constraint metrics as kfn.
aknn.notes: Same provenance as kfn (PRELIMINARY rows until the first full paper-setting job). colt_phl_paper is read off the paper's Figure 8b (max aggregate, A=15%, d=0.001, ~24k objects) and is approximate; the paper reports AkNN candidates only at this density.

log10_candidate_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|P|+1)/(objects revealed+1)); 0 = every object retrieved individually.

log10_call_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|Q||P|+1)/(exact distance computations+1)); 0 = brute force.

exact_answer_rate.description: Fraction of exact answers (ties at the k-th aggregate distance accepted). Any failure scores the method with the worst value of every metric.

index_entries_per_vertex.description: Landmark distance-list entries per vertex. Capped at 24 for AkNN.

sdl_work_per_vertex.description: Vertices settled while building the landmark distance lists, per vertex. Capped at 400.

range.description: Exact range search (radius 2.5% of the network diameter). Same benefit and constraint metrics as kfn.
range.notes: Same provenance as kfn (PRELIMINARY rows until the first full paper-setting job). colt_phl_paper is read off the paper's Figure 13d (r=2.5% D, d=0.0001, ~2.4k objects) and is approximate.

log10_candidate_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|P|+1)/(objects revealed+1)); 0 = every object retrieved individually.

log10_call_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|P|+1)/(exact distance computations+1)); 0 = brute force.

exact_answer_rate.description: Fraction of queries whose returned set equals the exact in-range set. Any failure scores the method with the worst value of every metric.

index_entries_per_vertex.description: Landmark distance-list entries per vertex. Capped at 24 for range.

sdl_work_per_vertex.description: Vertices settled while building the landmark distance lists, per vertex. Capped at 400.
